description: Java entity class representing product images within the sales manager application, including annotations for ORM mapping and fields related to image properties and associations.

classes.name: ProductImage
classes.description: Entity class for product images, handling image metadata, associations, and image content stream.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the image filename or path.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the image filename or path.

methods.name: isDefaultImage
methods.description: Checks if this image is the default for its product.

methods.name: setDefaultImage
methods.description: Sets whether this image is the default.

methods.name: getImageType
methods.description: Returns the image type as an integer.

methods.name: isImageCrop
methods.description: Checks if the image is cropped.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the image.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates the image with a product.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the image.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image as an InputStream.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image as an InputStream.
